routes.label: Scale the paint for five rooms

question: Paula the painter had just enough paint for \(30\) identically sized rooms. Unfortunately, on the way to work, three cans of paint fell off her truck, so she had only enough paint for \(25\) rooms. How many cans of paint did she use for the \(25\) rooms?
solution:
The three lost cans would have painted \(30-25=5\) rooms. Since the rooms are identically sized, the paint needed scales directly with the number of rooms.

Twenty-five rooms are \(25\div5=5\) times as many rooms, so they require \(5\cdot3=\boxed{15}\) cans, choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
